# A small RFC without a Problem

## Summary

Change the exit code of an existing baseline from 0 to 1. You sign off on the new code.

## Decisions

1. Exit 1. Recommended.

## Design detail

The exit code is set in `baseline.py`.

## Requirements

No new behavioral requirements: a fixture.
